translations.web: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.
translations.bsb: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
translations.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
translations.asv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing for joy before Jehovah; For he cometh to judge the earth.
